plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he recently learned that the astronomer J. Allen Hynek provided a computer to Paul Bennewitz, a man near Albuquerque, New Mexico, who believed he was picking up alien signals in the 1980s. Michels says Bennewitz was the target of a psyop, a deliberate campaign to mislead him, run by Rick Doty, an Air Force officer. If true, it would tie a well-known UFO scientist to one of the government's efforts to feed false stories to a believer.
